newsitem.title: UK: NWE Naphtha off highs but well supported.
newsitem.headline: NWE Naphtha off highs but well supported.

text.p: NWE spot naphtha prices eased from the early highs as crude dipped, but premiums to quotes related contracts held steady supported by good demand.
"The market is very well supported by demand, particulary in the Med, from refiners for platformer feedstocks," a trader with a U.K. major said, adding that N+A material was still scarce.
N+A and full range barrels were notionally valued around high cif +$3 at a premium to LVN which was valued high cif flat.
Traders said that despite the good demand outright business was thin with crude-led volatility keeping buyers and sellers at a standoff and Skikda maintenance limiting avails.
